articles.summary: NEW YORK, May 12, 2025 /PRNewswire/ — Lument Finance Trust, Inc. (NYSE: LFT) (“we”, “LFT” or “the Company”) today reported its first quarter results. GAAP net loss attributable to common shareholders for the first quarter was $1.7 million, or $0.03 per share of common stock.
